title: एकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 31 · Bhima's fury and the end of the day

summary.en: Bhima, unable to endure the checking of his army, attacks Bahlika and the Kaurava champions in a savage hand-to-hand fight. The day ends with both armies bloodied and weary at sunset.
summary.kn: ತನ್ನ ಸೈನ್ಯ ತಡೆಯಲ್ಪಟ್ಟುದನ್ನು ಸಹಿಸದ ಭೀಮ ಬಾಹ್ಲೀಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌರವ ವೀರರ ಮೇಲೆ ಭೀಕರ ಕೈಕೈ ಹೋರಾಟ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡೂ ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ರಕ್ತಸಿಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ದಣಿಯುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: अपनी सेना के रुकने को न सह पाने वाले भीम बाह्लीक और कौरव वीरों पर आक्रमण कर भयंकर हाथापाई करते हैं। सूर्यास्त पर दोनों सेनाएँ रक्त से सनी थकी हुई होती हैं।
summary.te: తన సేన ఆగిపోవడాన్ని సహించలేని భీముడు బాహ్లీకునిపై, కౌరవ వీరులపై దాడి చేసి భయంకర చేతిపోరు సాగిస్తాడు. సూర్యాస్తమయంలో ఇరు సేనలు రక్తసిక్తమై అలసిపోతాయి.
summary.ta: தன் படை தடுக்கப்படுவதைப் பொறுக்காத பீமன் பாஹ்லீகனையும் கௌரவ வீரர்களையும் தாக்கிக் கொடிய கைச்சண்டை செய்கிறான். மாலையில் இரு படைகளும் இரத்தம் தோய்ந்து களைக்கின்றன.
summary.ml: തന്റെ സേനയെ തടഞ്ഞുനിർത്തുന്നത് സഹിക്കാനാകാതെ ഭീമൻ ബാഹ്ലികനെയും കൗരവ വീരന്മാരെയും ക്രൂരമായ മെയ്പ്പോരിൽ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു. ഇരുസേനകളും രക്തം പുരണ്ടും തളർന്നും സൂര്യാസ്തമയത്തിൽ ദിവസം അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.31; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
प्रतिघातं तु सैन्यस्य नामृष्यत वृकोदरः ।
सोऽभिनद्बाह्लिकं षष्ट्या कर्णं च दशभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Vrikodara could not bear the setback to the army; he pierced Bahlika with sixty arrows and Karna with ten.

verses.text:
तस्य द्रोणः शितैर्बाणैस्तीक्ष्णधारैरयस्मयैः ।
जीवितान्तमभिप्रेप्सुर्मर्मण्याशु जघान ह ॥

meaning.en: Drona, wishing to end his life, quickly struck Bhima in his vitals with sharp, keen-edged iron arrows.

verses.text:
कर्णो द्वादशभिर्बाणैरश्वत्थामा च सप्तभिः ।
षड्भिर्दुर्योधनो राजा तत एनमवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Karna struck him with twelve arrows, Ashvatthaman with seven, and King Duryodhana then covered him with six.

verses.text:
भीमसेनोऽपि तान्सर्वान्प्रत्यविध्यन्महाबलः ।
द्रोणं पञ्चाशतेषूणां कर्णं च दशभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Bhimasena pierced them all in return: Drona with fifty arrows, Karna with ten,

verses.text:
दुर्योधनं द्वादशभिर्द्रौणिं चाष्टाभिराशुगैः ।
आरावं तुमुलं कुर्वन्नभ्यवर्तत तान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana with twelve, and Drona's son with eight swift ones; roaring tumultuously, he turned on them in battle.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्संत्यजति प्राणान्मृत्युसाधारणीकृते ।
अजातशत्रुस्तान्योधान्भीमं त्रातेत्यचोदयत् ॥

meaning.en: As Bhima risked his life, as good as handed over to death, Ajatashatru urged those warriors on: "Save Bhima!"

verses.text:
ते ययुर्भीमसेनस्य समीपममितौजसः ।
युयुधानप्रभृतयो माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki and the others, of boundless strength, and the two Pandava sons of Madri went to Bhimasena's side.

verses.text:
ते समेत्य सुसंरब्धाः सहिताः पुरुषर्षभाः ।
महेष्वासवरैर्गुप्तं द्रोणानीकं बिभित्सवः ॥

meaning.en: Those best of men, together in great fury, wishing to break Drona's division guarded by the best archers, gathered there.

verses.text:
समापेतुर्महावीर्या भीमप्रभृतयो रथाः ।
तान्प्रत्यगृह्णादव्यग्रो द्रोणोऽपि रथिनां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Those great chariot-warriors led by Bhima, of great valor, closed in, and Drona, best of charioteers, met them without wavering.

verses.text:
महाबलानतिरथान्वीरान्समरशोभिनः ।
बाह्यं मृत्युभयं कृत्वा तावकाः पाण्डवान्ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Putting aside the outer fear of death, your men went against the Pandavas, those strong, supremely great chariot-warriors, heroes who adorned the battle.

verses.text:
सादिनः सादिनोऽभ्यघ्नंस्तथैव रथिनो रथान् ।
आसीच्छक्त्यसिसंपातो युद्धमासीत्परश्वधैः ॥

meaning.en: Horsemen struck horsemen, chariot-warriors struck chariot-warriors; there was a fall of spears and swords, and a fight with axes.

verses.text:
निकृष्टमसियुद्धं च बभूव कटुकोदयम् ।
कुञ्जराणां च संघातैर्युद्धमासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: There was close sword-fighting, bitter in its outcome, and a terrible fight of masses of elephants.

verses.text:
अपतत्कुञ्जरादन्यो हयादन्यस्त्ववाक्शिराः ।
नरो बाणेन निर्भिन्नो रथादन्यश्च मारिष ॥

meaning.en: One man fell from an elephant, another headfirst from a horse, another pierced by an arrow from his chariot, O sir.

verses.text:
तत्रान्यस्य च संमर्दे पतितस्य विवर्मणः ।
शिरः प्रध्वंसयामास वक्षस्याक्रम्य कुञ्जरः ॥

meaning.en: In the crush an elephant stepped on the chest of a fallen, armorless man and crushed his head.

verses.text:
अपरेऽप्यपराञ्जघ्नुर्वारणाः पतितान्नरान् ।
विषाणैश्चावनिं गत्वा व्यभिन्दन्रथिनो बहून् ॥

meaning.en: Other elephants killed other fallen men, and, going down to the ground with their tusks, tore apart many chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
नरान्त्रैः केचिदपरे विषाणालग्नसंस्रवैः ।
बभ्रमुः शतशो नागा मृद्नन्तः शतशो नरान् ॥

meaning.en: Some elephants ranged about with men's entrails and streaming blood caught on their tusks, trampling men by the hundreds.

verses.text:
कांस्यायसतनुत्राणान्नराश्वरथकुञ्जरान् ।
पतितान्पोथयां चक्रुर्द्विपाः स्थूलनडानिव ॥

meaning.en: Elephants trampled fallen men, horses, chariots and elephants in armor of bronze and iron as if they were thick reeds.

verses.text:
गृध्रपत्राधिवासांसि शयनानि नराधिपाः ।
ह्रीमन्तः कालसंपक्वाः सुदुःखान्यधिशेरते ॥

meaning.en: Kings, ashamed, ripened by time, lay on beds covered with vulture feathers, in great pain.

verses.text:
हन्ति स्मात्र पिता पुत्रं रथेनाभ्यतिवर्तते ।
पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहान्निर्मर्यादमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Here a father killed his son and drove past in his chariot, and a son, from confusion, did the same to his father; all bounds were lost.

verses.text:
अक्षो भग्नो ध्वजश्छिन्नश्छत्रमुर्व्यां निपातितम् ।
युगार्धं छिन्नमादाय प्रदुद्राव तथा हयः ॥

meaning.en: An axle was broken, a banner cut, an umbrella thrown on the ground; a horse ran off carrying half a yoke.

verses.text:
सासिर्बाहुर्निपतितः शिरश्छिन्नं सकुण्डलम् ।
गजेनाक्षिप्य बलिना रथः संचूर्णितः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: An arm with its sword fell, a head with earrings was cut off, and a chariot was torn apart and crushed on the ground by a strong elephant.

verses.text:
रथिना ताडितो नागो नाराचेनापतद्व्यसुः ।
सारोहश्चापतद्वाजी गजेनाताडितो भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: An elephant struck by a chariot-warrior with an iron arrow fell lifeless; a horse with its rider fell, heavily struck by an elephant.

verses.text:
निर्मर्यादं महद्युद्धमवर्तत सुदारुणम् ।
हा तात हा पुत्र सखे क्वासि तिष्ठ क्व धावसि ॥

meaning.en: A great, terrible, boundless battle went on; cries were heard: "Alas, father! Alas, son! Friend, where are you? Stand! Where do you run?"

verses.text:
प्रहराहर जह्येनं स्मितक्ष्वेडितगर्जितैः ।
इत्येवमुच्चरन्त्यः स्म श्रूयन्ते विविधा गिरः ॥

meaning.en: "Strike! Strike! Kill him!" With smiles, shouts and roars, these many kinds of speech were heard.

verses.text:
नरस्याश्वस्य नागस्य समसज्जत शोणितम् ।
उपाशाम्यद्रजो भौमं भीरून्कश्मलमाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: The blood of men, horses and elephants joined together; the earth's dust settled, and faintness entered the cowards.

verses.text:
आसीत्केशपरामर्शो मुष्टियुद्धं च दारुणम् ।
नखैर्दन्तैश्च शूराणामद्वीपे द्वीपमिच्छताम् ॥

meaning.en: There was hair-pulling and terrible fist-fighting, with nails and teeth, among brave men seeking an island where there was none.

verses.text:
तत्राच्छिद्यत वीरस्य सखड्गो बाहुरुद्यतः ।
सधनुश्चापरस्यापि सशरः साङ्कुशस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: There one hero's raised arm with its sword was cut off; another's with his bow, and another's with arrow and goad.

verses.text:
प्राक्रोशदन्यमन्योऽत्र तथान्यो विमुखोऽद्रवत् ।
अन्यः प्राप्तस्य चान्यस्य शिरः कायादपाहरत् ॥

meaning.en: One cried out to another, another turned and fled, another cut the head from the body of a man who had reached him.

verses.text:
शब्दमभ्यद्रवच्चान्यः शब्दादन्योऽद्रवद्भृशम् ।
स्वानन्योऽथ परानन्यो जघान निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: One ran toward a sound, another ran hard from the sound; one killed his own, another his enemies, with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
गिरिशृङ्गोपमश्चात्र नाराचेन निपातितः ।
मातङ्गो न्यपतद्भूमौ नदीरोध इवोष्णगे ॥

meaning.en: A mountain-peak-like elephant, struck down by an iron arrow, fell to the ground like a river bank collapsing in summer.

verses.text:
तथैव रथिनं नागः क्षरन्गिरिरिवारुजत् ।
अध्यतिष्ठत्पदा भूमौ सहाश्वं सहसारथिम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise an elephant streaming rut-fluid, like a mountain, crushed a chariot-warrior, and with its foot pressed him into the ground with his horse and charioteer.

verses.text:
शूरान्प्रहरतो दृष्ट्वा कृतास्त्रान्रुधिरोक्षितान् ।
बहूनप्याविशन्मोहो भीरून्हृदयदुर्बलान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the brave strikers, skilled in weapons and drenched in blood, bewilderment seized even many of the faint-hearted cowards.

verses.text:
सर्वमाविग्नमभवन्न प्राज्ञायत किंचन ।
सैन्ये च रजसा ध्वस्ते निर्मर्यादमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Everything was agitated and nothing could be made out; with the army hidden by dust, all order was lost.

verses.text:
ततः सेनापतिः शीघ्रमयं काल इति ब्रुवन् ।
नित्याभित्वरितानेव त्वरयामास पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then the commander, saying "This is the moment," swiftly urged on the Pandavas, who were always hurrying.

verses.text:
कुर्वन्तः शासनं तस्य पाण्डवेया यशस्विनः ।
सरो हंसा इवापेतुर्घ्नन्तो द्रोणरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Obeying his command, the glorious Pandavas fell like swans into a lake, striking toward Drona's chariot.

verses.text:
गृह्णीताद्रवतान्योन्यं विभीता विनिकृन्तत ।
इत्यासीत्तुमुलः शब्दो दुर्धर्षस्य रथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: "Seize him! Run at each other! Do not be afraid! Cut him down!" A tumultuous noise rose around the chariot of the unassailable Drona.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो द्रौणी राजा जयद्रथः ।
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ शल्यश्चैनानवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, Kripa, Karna, Drona's son, King Jayadratha, Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, and Shalya held them back.

verses.text:
ते त्वार्यधर्मसंरब्धा दुर्निवार्या दुरासदाः ।
शरार्ता न जहुर्द्रोणं पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Yet the Panchalas with the Pandavas, roused by the duty of noble men, hard to restrain and hard to approach, tormented by arrows, did not let go of Drona.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणोऽभिसंक्रुद्धो विसृजञ्शतशः शरान् ।
चेदिपाञ्चालपाण्डूनामकरोत्कदनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, greatly angered, loosing hundreds of arrows, caused great slaughter among the Chedis, Panchalas and Pandavas.

verses.text:
तस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषः शुश्रुवे दिक्षु मारिष ।
वज्रसंघातसंकाशस्त्रासयन्पाण्डवान्बहून् ॥

meaning.en: The sound of his bowstring against his palm was heard in every direction, O sir, like a crash of thunderbolts, terrifying many Pandavas.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जिष्णुर्हत्वा संशप्तकान्बली ।
अभ्ययात्तत्र यत्र स्म द्रोणः पाण्डून्प्रमर्दति ॥

meaning.en: Meanwhile strong Jishnu, having killed the Samshaptakas, came to where Drona was crushing the Pandavas.

verses.text:
तं शरौघमहावर्तं शोणितोदं महाह्रदम् ।
तीर्णः संशप्तकान्हत्वा प्रत्यदृश्यत फल्गुनः ॥

meaning.en: Having crossed that great pool of blood with whirlpools of floods of arrows, having killed the Samshaptakas, Phalguna appeared.

verses.text:
तस्य कीर्तिमतो लक्ष्म सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसः ।
दीप्यमानमपश्याम तेजसा वानरध्वजम् ॥

meaning.en: We saw the blazing banner with the ape on it, the sign of that renowned man of sun-like splendor.

verses.text:
संशप्तकसमुद्रं तमुच्छोष्यास्त्रगभस्तिभिः ।
स पाण्डवयुगान्तार्कः कुरूनप्यभ्यतीतपत् ॥

meaning.en: Having dried up the ocean of the Samshaptakas with the rays of his weapons, that Pandava, sun of the end of the age, scorched the Kurus too.

verses.text:
प्रददाह कुरून्सर्वानर्जुनः शस्त्रतेजसा ।
युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि धूमकेतुरिवोत्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna burned all the Kurus with the fire of his weapons, like a comet rising at the end of the age against all beings.

verses.text:
तेन बाणसहस्रौघैर्गजाश्वरथयोधिनः ।
ताड्यमानाः क्षितिं जग्मुर्मुक्तशस्त्राः शरार्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by his thousands of floods of arrows, fighters on elephants, horses and chariots fell to the earth, their weapons dropped, tormented by arrows.

verses.text:
केचिदार्तस्वरं चक्रुर्विनेदुरपरे पुनः ।
पार्थबाणहताः केचिन्निपेतुर्विगतासवः ॥

meaning.en: Some cried out in pain, others roared again, some struck by Partha's arrows fell lifeless.

verses.text:
तेषामुत्पततां कांश्चित्पतितांश्च पराङ्मुखान् ।
न जघानार्जुनो योधान्योधव्रतमनुस्मरन् ॥

meaning.en: Remembering the warrior's code, Arjuna did not strike those warriors who jumped up, fell, or turned their backs.

verses.text:
ते विशीर्णरथाश्वेभाः प्रायशश्च पराङ्मुखाः ।
कुरवः कर्ण कर्णेति हा हेति च विचुक्रुशुः ॥

meaning.en: The Kurus, their chariots, horses and elephants scattered, mostly turned away, cried out "Karna! Karna!" and "Alas!"

verses.text:
तमाधिरथिराक्रन्दं विज्ञाय शरणैषिणाम् ।
मा भैष्टेति प्रतिश्रुत्य ययावभिमुखोऽर्जुनम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that cry from those seeking shelter, the son of Adhiratha promised, "Do not fear," and went to meet Arjuna.

verses.text:
स भारतरथश्रेष्ठः सर्वभारतहर्षणः ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे तदाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ॥

meaning.en: That best of Bharata chariot-warriors, who gladdened all the Bharatas, best of those who know weapons, then brought forth the fire weapon.

verses.text:
तस्य दीप्तशरौघस्य दीप्तचापधरस्य च ।
शरौघाञ्शरजालेन विदुधाव धनंजयः ।
अस्त्रमस्त्रेण संवार्य प्राणदद्विसृजञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: Dhananjaya met the floods of arrows of him, with his blazing floods of arrows and blazing bow, with a net of arrows, countering weapon with weapon and loosing arrows.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च भीमश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः ।
विव्यधुः कर्णमासाद्य त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima and the great chariot-warrior Satyaki approached Karna and each pierced him with three straight-flying arrows.

verses.text:
अर्जुनास्त्रं तु राधेयः संवार्य शरवृष्टिभिः ।
तेषां त्रयाणां चापानि चिच्छेद विशिखैस्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Radheya countered Arjuna's weapon with showers of arrows, and with three arrows cut the bows of the three of them.

verses.text:
ते निकृत्तायुधाः शूरा निर्विषा भुजगा इव ।
रथशक्तीः समुत्क्षिप्य भृशं सिंहा इवानदन् ॥

meaning.en: Their weapons cut, those brave men, like serpents without venom, raised their chariot-spears and roared loudly like lions.

verses.text:
ता भुजाग्रैर्महावेगा विसृष्टा भुजगोपमाः ।
दीप्यमाना महाशक्त्यो जग्मुराधिरथिं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Hurled from their hands with great speed, those great blazing spears, like serpents, flew at the son of Adhiratha.

verses.text:
ता निकृत्य शितैर्बाणैस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ।
ननाद बलवान्कर्णः पार्थाय विसृजञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: Cutting each of them down with three straight arrows, strong Karna roared and loosed arrows at Partha.

verses.text:
अर्जुनश्चापि राधेयं विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः ।
कर्णादवरजं बाणैर्जघान निशितैस्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna too pierced Radheya with seven swift arrows, and with three sharp arrows killed Karna's younger brother.

verses.text:
ततः शत्रुंजयं हत्वा पार्थः षड्भिरजिह्मगैः ।
जहार सद्यो भल्लेन विपाटस्य शिरो रथात् ॥

meaning.en: Then Partha killed Shatrunjaya with six straight arrows, and with a broad-headed arrow swiftly took Vipata's head from his chariot.

verses.text:
पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणामेकेनैव किरीटिना ।
प्रमुखे सूतपुत्रस्य सोदर्या निहतास्त्रयः ॥

meaning.en: As the Dhritarashtras looked on, the diadem-wearer alone killed three brothers of the Charioteer's son in front of him.

verses.text:
ततो भीमः समुत्पत्य स्वरथाद्वैनतेयवत् ।
वरासिना कर्णपक्षाञ्जघान दश पञ्च च ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima leapt from his chariot like Garuda and with a fine sword killed fifteen of Karna's wing-guards.

verses.text:
पुनः स्वरथमास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम् ।
विव्याध दशभिः कर्णं सूतमश्वांश्च पञ्चभिः ॥

meaning.en: Mounting his chariot again and taking another bow, he pierced Karna with ten arrows, and his charioteer and horses with five.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नोऽप्यसिवरं चर्म चादाय भास्वरम् ।
जघान चन्द्रवर्माणं बृहत्क्षत्रं च पौरवम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna too took a fine sword and shining shield and killed Chandravarman and the Paurava Brihatkshatra.

verses.text:
ततः स्वरथमास्थाय पाञ्चाल्योऽन्यच्च कार्मुकम् ।
आदाय कर्णं विव्याध त्रिसप्तत्या नदन्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then the Panchala, mounting his own chariot and taking another bow, roaring in battle, pierced Karna with seventy-three arrows.

verses.text:
शैनेयोऽप्यन्यदादाय धनुरिन्द्रायुधद्युति ।
सूतपुत्रं चतुःषष्ट्या विद्ध्वा सिंह इवानदत् ॥

meaning.en: Shaineya also took another bow, shining like a rainbow, pierced the Charioteer's son with sixty-four arrows and roared like a lion.

verses.text:
भल्लभ्यां साधुमुक्ताभ्यां छित्त्वा कर्णस्य कार्मुकम् ।
पुनः कर्णं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: With two well-loosed broad-headed arrows he cut down Karna's bow, and then struck Karna with three arrows in his arms and chest.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो द्रोणो राजा चैव जयद्रथः ।
निमज्जमानं राधेयमुज्जह्रुः सात्यकार्णवात् ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, Drona and King Jayadratha lifted Radheya out of the sea of Satyaki as he was sinking.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च भीमश्च सौभद्रोऽर्जुन एव च ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिं जुगुपू रणे ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima, Subhadra's son, Arjuna, Nakula and Sahadeva protected Satyaki in the battle.

verses.text:
एवमेष महारौद्रः क्षयार्थं सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
तावकानां परेषां च त्यक्त्वा प्राणानभूद्रणः ॥

meaning.en: So this fearsome battle, for the destruction of all archers of your side and theirs, went on, with lives cast away.

verses.text:
पदातिरथनागाश्वैर्गजाश्वरथपत्तयः ।
रथिनो नागपत्त्यश्वै रथपत्ती रथद्विपैः ॥

meaning.en: Foot soldiers fought with chariots, elephants and horses; elephants, horses, chariots and infantry together; chariot-warriors with elephants, foot soldiers and horses; chariots and infantry with chariots and elephants.

verses.text:
अश्वैरश्वा गजैर्नागा रथिनो रथिभिः सह ।
संसक्ताः समदृश्यन्त पत्तयश्चापि पत्तिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Horses with horses, elephants with elephants, chariot-warriors with chariot-warriors, and infantry with infantry were seen locked together.

verses.text:
एवं सुकलिलं युद्धमासीत्क्रव्यादहर्षणम् ।
महद्भिस्तैरभीतानां यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: So the tangled battle, gladdening the flesh-eaters, went on, and it enlarged Yama's realm for those great, fearless men.

verses.text:
ततो हता नररथवाजिकुञ्जरै-
रनेकशो द्विपरथवाजिपत्तयः ।
गजैर्गजा रथिभिरुदायुधा रथा
हयैर्हयाः पत्तिगणैश्च पत्तयः ॥

meaning.en: Then, killed by men, chariots, horses and elephants, many elephants, chariots, horses and foot soldiers fell: elephants by elephants, chariot-warriors with raised weapons by chariot-warriors, horses by horses, and infantry by infantry.

verses.text:
रथैर्द्विपा द्विरदवरैर्महाहया
हयैर्नरा वररथिभिश्च वाजिनः ।
निरस्तजिह्वादशनेक्षणाः क्षितौ
क्षयं गताः प्रमथितवर्मभूषणाः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants by chariots, great horses by fine elephants, men by horses, and horses by fine chariot-warriors; with tongues, teeth and eyes thrown out, with armor and ornaments crushed, they perished on the ground.

verses.text:
तथा परैर्बहुकरणैर्वरायुधै-
र्हता गताः प्रतिभयदर्शनाः क्षितिम् ।
विपोथिता हयगजपादताडिता
भृशाकुला रथखुरनेमिभिर्हताः ॥

meaning.en: Struck down by others with many weapons and fine arms, they fell to the earth with fearful looks, trampled by horses and elephants, crushed under feet, in great distress, killed by chariot wheels and hooves.

verses.text:
प्रमोदने श्वापदपक्षिरक्षसां
जनक्षये वर्तति तत्र दारुणे ।
महाबलास्ते कुपिताः परस्परं
निषूदयन्तः प्रविचेरुरोजसा ॥

meaning.en: In that terrible destruction of people, a joy to beasts, birds and Rakshasas, those mighty men, enraged at one another, ranged about with force, killing.

verses.text:
ततो बले भृशलुलिते परस्परं
निरीक्षमाणे रुधिरौघसंप्लुते ।
दिवाकरेऽस्तंगिरिमास्थिते शनै-
रुभे प्रयाते शिबिराय भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the armies were greatly shaken, looking at one another, drowned in floods of blood, the sun slowly reached the western mountain, and both sides, O Bharata, went to their camps.
